messages:
maya: Heads up — I hit a parity bug in the Ruby SDK auth retry. sampleapp fails to refresh token on 401, it just surfaces an auth error instead of retrying with the refresh token. CI started failing after the last vendored Faraday bump.

sam: Can you paste the failing log? PR link?

maya: Pasting minimal repro / log below. Happens on macOS runner and locally too.

maya: ```
Faraday::Unauthorized: 401 Unauthorized
from /usr/local/bundle/gems/faraday-1.12.0/lib/faraday/response.rb:...
# sampleapp/bin/refresh_test.rb shows the client never calls TokenRefresher.refresh
```

ci-bot: [CI] ruby/matrix: failed test_ruby_auth_refresh_spec on ubuntu-22.04, macos-13 (job 5421)

chris: I think this is the same coupling issue we saw with the middleware order after the Faraday bump. Try pinning faraday or bundler for a quick CI green: `gem 'faraday', '~> 1.12'` or `bundle update --bundler`. I had `bundle update --bundler` fix a similar local flake.

jordan: FYI the Windows runner shows a transient matrix flake, but the auth-refresh repro is consistent on macOS. @maya can you run `BUNDLE_GEMFILE=Gemfile.ci bundle exec rspec spec/auth_refresh_spec.rb -fd` locally?

maya: Running that now. Repro steps I used: 
``
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=expired
ruby sampleapp/bin/refresh_test.rb
```
It dies with `Faraday::Unauthorized` before refresh flow kicks in. Stack: 
``
Faraday::Unauthorized: 401 Unauthorized
from /usr/local/bundle/gems/faraday-1.12.0/lib/faraday/response.rb:...
```

sam: Could be middleware ordering + a `retry` flag. We landed a change that flips retry behavior in the client initializer. If `retry: false` is set on the Faraday connection it will short-circuit some of our recover/refresh logic.

maya: Yup I see `connection_options[:request][:retry] = false` in the Ruby client init — that was added to avoid double-retries during streaming. I'll try toggling it to `nil` and add an explicit rescue for token-refresh paths.

maya: Quick patch pushed: removed the explicit `retry: false` and added targeted rescues for 429/5xx while keeping streaming behavior intact. Opened PR #7832 with a tiny regression spec.

ci-bot: [CI] PR 7832 — ruby-sdk: auth retry fix — checks: lint ✅, unit ✅, matrix: ubuntu failed, macos passed (rerun queued)

sam: I'll review the PR. Can you add a spec that simulates: 401 -> refresh -> 200 so we don't regress again? Keep it lightweight.

maya: Added the mock spec and a changelog entry. Also pinned bundler in Gemfile.ci to 2.3.14 to avoid the CI matrix flake while we stabilize.

chris: :shipit: Nice catch. One small docstring nit in TokenRefresher but behavior looks correct.

sam: Left a tiny naming nit on the helper method. Approving once that's addressed.

maya: Addressed the nit, pushed, CI green across matrix now. Thanks all :tada: 

jordan: Can we backport this to the 0.8.x maintenance branch? A couple enterprise customers are still on it.

maya: Yep opening backport PR momentarily.

sam: Thanks — please add a short note in release notes about the bundler pin + auth retry edge case so CS can nudge impacted customers.

maya: Will do. Closing this thread.
